back: Work done per unit time; the rate of energy transfer.
One joule per second; kg m² s⁻³ in base units.

front: Power of a force moving at velocity v
Vehicle at constant speed on a level road
back: Driving force = total resistive force; power output = resistive force × speed.

front: Condition for top speed at full power
back: P_max / v = total resistive force, so the resultant force is zero.

front: Useful power of a pump lifting water
back: (mass of water per second) × g × height (+ kinetic energy given per second)
useful power output ÷ total power input × 100%
